interface.shortDescription: Spec-first process skills for real projects.
interface.longDescription: Forge packages a complete spec-first workflow - brainstorm to spec, spec to plan, plan to verified implementation - plus one-source authoring for Codex, Claude Code, and Antigravity skills and MCP configurations, UI design, tone overlays, systematic debugging, TDD, and lifecycle HTML review Viewers. Specs, plans, and canonical agent extensions remain source of truth while generated adapters and views stay derived.
